title: Sorting out when he first knew Tatum
summary: Roy tries to place when he met Tatum, Toledo, Cleveland or New York.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: Now, when we're talking about Tatum and all of that, that's a little later.
Yeah, that's like from '33 to '34. No, no! That's during the time of the Small's Paradise days!
Because earlier you said you didn't really...
Now, wait a minute. Let me get it straight now.
...get to know him until you went with McKinney's, which is later, I think. Right?

Now, I was with McKinney's Cotton Pickers in '33 and '34. Now, in the hell did...? Now, there's something strange about that some kind of way. Because when he first came to New York, I was working at Small's!
Maybe... Oh, you know what it is? I think I met him in Toledo when I was with Speed Webb. Yeah! Either Toledo or Detroit. That's where I... Yeah, Toledo!
Because that was his home town.
Yeah, that's where it come from. I was

trying to get that together, and I know I was at Small's. I had to be at Small's, you know? Because by the time I was... In 1934, around there, then I knew him around Cleveland; he was in Cleveland then.
